Miglė Rimkutė 
Once you applied for immigration they can’t guarantee that you would come as a tourist and leave on time. It’s an immigration risk because they know you have intentions to eventually stay here, but the ministry has not approved your request yet. I know it’s hard, but stay strong, it’s just a few extra months. Do everything properly and it’ll save you A LOT of headache. In the meantime you could meet in Lithuania or in some other 3rd country and spend some time there instead. That’s what I did with my Finnish wife until she received the official invitation.
